title.zh: 在萨兰加尼省首府Alabel镇设立国立科学中学，名称为Alabel国立科学中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National Science High School in the Capital Town of Alabel, Province of Sarangani to Be Known as Alabel National Science High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National Science High School in the Capital Town of Alabel, Province of Sarangani to Be Known as Alabel National Science High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông khoa học quốc gia tại Thị trấn tỉnh lỵ Alabel, Tỉnh Sarangani được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông khoa học quốc gia Alabel
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมวิทยาศาสตร์แห่งชาติในเมืองหลวงของจังหวัด Alabel, จังหวัด Sarangani ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมวิทยาศาสตร์แห่งชาติ Alabel
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Sains Nasional di Kota Ibu Kota Alabel, Provinsi Sarangani dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Sains Nasional Alabel
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Sains Kebangsaan di Pekan Ibu Wilayah Alabel, Wilayah Sarangani dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Sains Kebangsaan Alabel

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8078_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established a national science high school in the capital town of Alabel, Province of Sarangani, to be known as Alabel National Science High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
